'''Del Obarren''' served as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Regional Prefect]] of the [[o'beki]] of [[A'Lenba]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. A cold and hard individual, Obarren was pragmatic and had no sense of ethics or morality. People considered him to be cruel but he did not possess the level of emotion that cruelty needed.
